visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 current portable renders, including the retained 1024×640 summary. Three white onion domes, twin banded brick minarets with open lantern caps, cream cusped arcades, flat pale roofs, low connectors and selected corner chhatris are present. Rear windows have opaque panes visible from both sides. Galleries are open and unfurnished. Fine ornament, flags, signs, umbrellas and detached service structures are omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic-flat views, including the placement overlay. Five existing 256² graphs provide longformat brick, raw/coursed limestone, lime plaster and painted metal; six merged roles include local opaque glazing. Metric UVs and linear tints; no embedded images or unique atlas. Graphs are read once and model geometry is disposed on eviction. All 74 surrounding host buildings remain separate. The flat placement image checks pose and replacement; the retained DEM fixture supplies approximate ground contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 27 current medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late light, street/block/skyline, silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. Three domes, twin striped minarets and arcade rhythm persist at distance. Skyline keeps broad openings and solid small pavilion proxies. District keeps additional framed bays and open tall lanterns. Street restores coarse cusps; closeup restores more lobe points, inner frames, parapet points and small open chhatris. Distant trim was simplified to restore arch openings within budget. Whole portable views retain both complete minarets; shared detail cameras may crop their tips. Physical-device/full-city timing remains pending.

geographicReview.notes: Q1143296 retained reference point and current Jamek Mosque POI35184852806566 agree on the river-confluence mosque. Named Jamek Mosque POI identifies the central three-domed prayer hall at the river confluence. The contiguous main hall,its two attached side wings and low connecting strips are included;three roof parts and two32 m minaret plans refine that same structure. Nearby detached service/ablution buildings,river works,station,shops and courtyard pavement stay host content. No exact Wikidata-tagged footprint was retained;this is a current named-POI/map correspondence and approximate fit. Heading 1.257641544721982 rad follows the minimum-area rectangle of the central hall;positive Z faces the mapped minaret/entry side. Facing,part membership and roof partitions remain approximate visualization judgments. Standard Protomaps20261014 and Mapzen/USGS viewer extractN0474;datum 26.481141919133147 m. 398 footprint samples span -3.10996714439948 to 8.006455090112862 m. Floor 4.682367379640158 m is the median of 216 outer samples plus0.28 m. Footings sample edges at<=2.5 m. Replacement and preview seating use only seven selected body/connector/minaret masks;roof parts are already above the main body. Courtyard,detached service buildings,rivers,embankments and adjacent shops remain host content. Thresholds,stairs,water edges and exact grade joins are unverified. Independently reproduced all ten current plans / 86 vertices, the named mosque point and unchanged height tags. Seven selected body/connector/minaret masks preserve courtyard and river ground. All 504 footprint checks and 1,218 FrontSide probes pass. Those probes cover open galleries, opaque rear windows on both sides, roofs/floors, both 32 m tower tips, open lanterns and seated foundations. The 398 footprint, 216 outer and 513 seated preview samples reproduce the 16-bit terrain fixture. Three outside points remain outside the masks.
